description: Start monitoring Twitter/X account(s) for follow activity. The response includes account.username — the account every call runs and bills as. Surface it to the user at the start of a session, and stop if it is not who they expect. Pass `usernames` (an array, max 50) to onboard a whole list in ONE call instead of one call per handle - always prefer that for more than one account. Partial success is normal: read each result's `status` (tracked / already_tracked / not_found / deferred / ...). Only accounts NEW to the platform draw on usage; accounts already in the shared coverage pool are free. At most 10 new-account introductions are attempted per request; handles beyond that come back "deferred" - resubmit just those.

max_credits.description: Optional spend ceiling for this one call. Fails closed: if the call could use more, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

usernames.description: Batch form: up to 50 Twitter/X handles to track in one call. Use instead of username when adding more than one.

name: frontrun_track
